# ComputationKey

`schemas/records/computation-key.json`

What a node would compute (docs/design/m0/13 "Model" [G1]). key is sha256 over the RFC 8785 form of {kind, definition_version, params (the params digest), inputs, generation}, computed by internal/graph: inputs are the declared inputs sorted by name, each {name, result} for a result input or {name, approval, revision} for an answer input. A key names a computation, never an output: a result has its own id and answers exactly one key, and each key has one selected result at a time.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) |  |
| `generation` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) | Starts at 1 and is bumped only by an explicit, recorded invalidation (an operator action, or a definition or instrument version change). A bump changes the key, so a new result is produced and dependants re-key; no result is ever overwritten. |

No other fields are allowed.
